summary: Ascendis Pharma A/S filed a Form 6-K announcing the completion of its transition from American Depositary Shares (ADSs) to ordinary shares listed on Nasdaq Global Select Market. The mandatory exchange occurred on April 20, 2026, with each ADS exchanged for one ordinary share under the same ticker 'ASND' and new CUSIP K08588103/ISIN DK0060606333. This represents a delisting of the ADS program and a direct listing of ordinary shares. The move eliminates the ADS structure, simplifying the company's capital market presence. Investors should monitor the post-exchange trading liquidity and any residual ADR overhang.
